scheme_name: Internship Policy Of Indian Council For Cultural Relations (ICCR)
other_conditions: The applicant must be a citizen of India.
The applicant must be a graduate in Humanities, Mass Communication, Journalism, Designing, Anthropology, History, Art, Archaeology Science, Languages, Museology or Fine Arts.
Post‑graduate / Research students and Foreign Language students are also eligible.
The applicant should have an excellent academic track record.
The applicant should preferably be from any recognized University in India.
Research scholars with formal backgrounds in International Relations and Soft Power Projection will be given preference depending upon ICCR’s requirement.
Candidates with the highest marks are most likely to be called for a personal interview.
benefits_summary: Interns receive a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000, a one‑time air‑fare allowance up to the prevailing economy class fare, logistical support, and a certificate upon satisfactory completion.
application_link: directoradmin.iccr@gov.in with a copy to spdadmn.iccr@gov.in (Dy. Director General, Administration, ICCR, Azad Bhavan, IP Estate, New Delhi)
